idea.title: monty-go: Pure-Go wrapper for Pydantic's Monty Python Interpreter

plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers with a simple CLI tool.
plan.problem: Freelancers waste hours chasing late payments manually, losing revenue and productivity.
plan.solution: A lightweight CLI that tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—no setup, no fluff.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small business owners who invoice clients and hate follow-ups.

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: SQLite schema + add/list commands with basic validation

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Overdue detection + SMTP email reminders + report generation

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Offline demo mode, help text, edge cases (e.g., invalid dates)

plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 invoices (1 overdue), auto-send a reminder, and generate a report—all offline with hardcoded data.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based freelancers/cafes who invoice tourists—auto-reminders reduce payment delays in cash-heavy markets.
